description: Abort an actual held read with queued guidance, then reuse its native session.
task: Call the admitted read-only mcp_corefixture_eval_barrier exactly once with the supplied eval tool arguments. Wait for its result before replying with the label mc-stop-original-v51. Do not call other tools or answer before the read finishes.

action.text: New request: reply exactly mc-stop-reused-c74. Do not use any tool or continue the canceled task.

rubric.description: The native stop ends the active task and queued guidance without a fabricated completion; the new same-session request receives its requested label without resuming the canceled task. Ignore runtime footer metadata.
